resume: From acknowledging the child before birth to choosing childcare: the administrative steps of the first months.

elements.titre: Acknowledge the child before birth (unmarried parents)
Apply for the prime à la naissance (birth grant) and the allocation de base (basic allowance)
elements.detail: Declare the pregnancy on time so you don't lose the grant.

elements.titre: Register the birth at the town hall (mairie)
Get or update the family record book (livret de famille)
Know how to get the child's birth certificate
elements.detail: It is free, and it will be requested for many procedures.

elements.titre: Add the baby to both parents' Carte Vitale (health insurance card)
Add the baby to the top-up health insurance (mutuelle)
Arrange check-ups and vaccinations (doctor or PMI, the mother and child health service)
Report the birth to the Caf (family benefits office) and check family allowances
elements.detail: In Martinique, they are paid from the first child.

elements.titre: Open a savings account for the child
